text:
alex: Heads-up — FinTrust wants a fully air-gapped POC in their on‑prem datacenter the week of May 18. They specifically asked about packaging format, upgrade cadence, and what we charge for offline installation + runbook/support.

tess: Quick clarifying Qs from their security team: must have signed bundles, SBOM per image, no egress telemetry, FIPS-compatible signing, and HSM-backed key material. They also asked about rollback plan if a delta patch fails.

ben: Feasible. We can produce signed tarballs (bundle-<version>.tar.gz) + detached sig (bundle.sig) and provide SBOMs. For airgap we support three delivery options: USB multi-part bundle, single tarball served from an internal HTTP mirror, or container image tarball with sha256. Rollback: we include previous bundle and a simple restore script in the runbook.

priya: Pricing ask from FinTrust: they want a line item for airgap packaging + image signing + one-time SOW for deployment validation. Ballpark numbers needed for the quote — also whether we require a Dedicated reserved commit or can run this on Hosted with offline bundle.

ben: Hosted is not possible in their threat model. For POC we recommend a short Dedicated pool (reserved) or bring-your-own infra with our Private deployment package. Airgap add-on: one-time packaging & signing SOW (est 40–80h) + annual support uplift (we usually do 15–25% of Dedicated list for airgap SLAs).

sam: Security questionnaire items to prep: key lifecycle (rotation schedule), attestation for SBOM provenance, image signing algorithm (ECDSA-P256 by default), proof of signed manifest, and supply-chain controls. They requested HSM integration — we support KMIP + PKCS#11 workflows for on-prem HSMs; for pure airgapped installs we can deliver pre-wrapped signing keys and a signing gateway that runs in their enclave.

alex: They also asked about upgrade cadence — what are our standard options? Monthly? Quarterly? Hotfix windows? And will upgrades require full bundle re-install or delta patches?

ben: Default is monthly security patches + quarterly feature bundles. For airgap customers we can do configurable cadences: quarterly (default for POC), monthly on request, or ad hoc emergency hotfixes. Delta patches are supported for minor updates via patch manifests (smaller payloads) — full bundle for major model or runtime changes. Hotfix SLA for enterprise: 48–72h triage + signed patch release.

priya: Client wants explicit wording in SOW that we will deliver signed SBOM + a verified install runbook, and an escalation path if a patch breaks production. Also they asked whether we will assist with cert rotation during their maintenance windows.

sam: We can include cert rotation assistance as part of the SOW (couple days of onsite/remote ops support). For HSM-backed signing we need their HSM vendor + model to validate PKCS#11 modules. Document that we store no private keys in our hosted systems for airgap bundles — signing performed in a controlled environment and only signed artifacts are handed off.

ops-bot: Deploy snippet for local signature verification:
```
# verify signature locally
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle-1.2.3.tar.gz
```

alex: Legal/compliance also flagged export control on quantized model weights — can we provide a statement?

ben: We can provide a tailored export-control attestation for models we ship in POC bundles; but must review model license & export lists first. For quantized weights (4-bit/8-bit) usually same as model binary — we'll add a legal checkbox in the SOW.

priya: Ok — next steps I'd propose: (1) eng to confirm final SOW estimate (hours + tasks), (2) security to draft the short attestation for SBOM/key handling, (3) sales to send provisional quote with airgap uplift and 90-day patch cadence option.

ben: I can do (1) — will scope 60h baseline for packaging + 16h for HSM validation + 8h runbook/testing = 84h baseline.

sam: I'll draft the attestation and list of questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow.

priya: I'll draft the commercial and include two options: Quarterly cadence (no uplift) vs Monthly cadence (+10% uplift) and one-time SOW fee = $X (to be filled once ben confirms). Sending to FinTrust once eng + sec signs off.

alex: Great — assign owners: @ben (packaging SOW), @sam (attestation & security Qs), @priya (quote). Tag me for final approval when ready. :thumbsup:

priya: Noted — thanks all.
